reason: Conversation 2 correctly read the flashing red light as the V10 battery-fault signal, ran sensible non-invasive checks (direct charge off the dock, socket, contacts, screws, temperature, blockage), confirmed the battery was not swollen/hot, warned that V7/V8/V11 packs won't fit, gave the correct SV12 pack and safe lithium disposal advice, and pointed to Dyson's troubleshooter — matching the expected direction almost exactly, with only mild overconfidence in 'that confirms it' (though it did acknowledge a motor/board fault as a residual possibility). Conversation 1 never engaged with what a flashing red light means or the months of falling runtime, ran generic template checks (including an irrelevant overheating/cool-for-an-hour step), and ended with a vague 'switch, cable or motor' list and a referral to a repairer with no part advice, leaving the homeowner no better informed than when they started.
